tools.name: check_property_tax_savings
tools.description: Free check of whether a California home qualifies for a Proposition 8 decline-in-value property tax reduction. Returns a status (qualifies, fair_assessment, not_enough_data, not_residential, window_closed, county_not_served, already_filed, address_not_found, needs_more_info, busy), the current asses

tools.name: start_filing
tools.description: Start a county filing for a property that qualified in check_property_tax_savings. Prepares the county's own review form and emails a signing link to the OWNER'S email address. The link is never returned here: the owner personally reviews, signs, and pays a flat $29 before anything is filed. Require

tools.name: get_filing_status
tools.description: Coarse status of a filing by document id: awaiting_signature, awaiting_payment, filed, delivered, or unknown. Returns no personal information, addresses, or amounts.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: start_filing · Private data: get_filing_status · Public sink: start_filing.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: start_filing · Private data: get_filing_status · Public sink: start_filing

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
